result.instructions: Tools for Neon CRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Neon CRM data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run neon_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run neon_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run neon_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. neon_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: neon_get_organization_profile
tools.title: Get the organization profile
tools.description: Fetch the Neon CRM organization these credentials belong to — its name, org ID and app URL. A cheap way to confirm the org ID and API key work. Neon: GET /properties/organizationProfile.

tools.name: neon_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List constituent accounts (individuals and companies), optionally filtered by email, first or last name, or type. Returns accountId, names, email and userType. For richer queries use neon_search. Neon: GET /accounts.

current_page.description: 0-based page number (Neon pages start at 0). Default 0.

tools.name: neon_get_account
tools.title: Get one account
tools.description: Fetch one account in full — returned as individualAccount or companyAccount with its primary contact, addresses, consent, custom fields, current membership status and timestamps. Neon: GET /accounts/{id}.

tools.name: neon_list_search_fields
tools.title: List search or output fields
tools.description: Discover the field names neon_search accepts for a resource: kind=searchFields gives filterable fields with their allowed operators; kind=outputFields gives the columns you can return (standard field names plus custom fields with numeric ids). Call this before neon_search. Neon: GET /{resource}/search/searchFields or /outputFields.

tools.name: neon_search
tools.title: Search records
tools.description: Report-style search over accounts, donations (includes pledges and pledge payments), activities or events. Give filter criteria (field + operator + value), the output columns to return (standard field NAMES as strings, or custom-field IDS as integers — both from neon_list_search_fields), and 0-based pagination. Results come back as searchResults rows keyed by output field name, plus pagination totals. Neon allows only ONE concurrent search per endpoint. Neon: POST /{resource}/search.

field.description: A search field name, e.g. 'Email' or 'Donation Date'.

operator.description: Comparison operator. BLANK/NOT_BLANK take no value.

value_list.description: A list of values, for IN_RANGE / NOT_IN_RANGE.

search_fields.description: Filter criteria, ANDed together. Neon requires at least one.

output_fields.description: Columns to return: standard field names (strings) and/or custom-field ids (integers). Max 300.

current_page.description: 0-based page number (Neon pages start at 0). Default 0.

sort_column.description: Output field name to sort by — it must also appear in output_fields.

tools.name: neon_list_account_donations
tools.title: List an account's donations
tools.description: List one account's donations (amount, date, fund, campaign, purpose, status, payments), newest first by default. Neon: GET /accounts/{id}/donations.

current_page.description: 0-based page number (Neon pages start at 0). Default 0.

tools.name: neon_list_account_memberships
tools.title: List an account's memberships
tools.description: List one account's membership history — level, term, start and end dates, fee, status (e.g. SUCCEEDED/FAILED) and auto-renewal. Filter to active or the primary active membership. Neon: GET /accounts/{id}/memberships.

is_active.description: Only memberships matching the account's Active member flag.

current_page.description: 0-based page number (Neon pages start at 0). Default 0.

tools.name: neon_list_account_event_registrations
tools.title: List an account's event registrations
tools.description: List the event registrations one account has made, optionally for a single event. Neon: GET /accounts/{id}/eventRegistrations.

current_page.description: 0-based page number (Neon pages start at 0). Default 0.

tools.name: neon_get_donation
tools.title: Get one donation
tools.description: Fetch one donation — amount, date, fund, campaign, purpose, source, tribute, soft-credit solicitor, payments and status. Neon: GET /donations/{id}.

tools.name: neon_get_membership
tools.title: Get one membership
tools.description: Fetch one membership — level, term, dates, fee, status, auto-renewal, sub-members and payments. Neon: GET /memberships/{membershipId}.

tools.name: neon_list_membership_levels
tools.title: List membership levels
tools.description: List the organization's membership levels (id, code, description, rank, type, status). Neon: GET /memberships/levels.

current_page.description: 0-based page number (Neon pages start at 0). Default 0.

tools.name: neon_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List events, filterable by name, category, date window, published or archived state. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Only Neon's legacy events are exposed by the API. Neon: GET /events.

event_category.description: Event category (a delimited list is allowed).

current_page.description: 0-based page number (Neon pages start at 0). Default 0.

tools.name: neon_get_event
tools.title: Get one event
tools.description: Fetch one event — name, summary, dates, location, capacity, category, campaign, registration and financial settings. Neon: GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: neon_list_event_registrations
tools.title: List an event's registrations
tools.description: List the registrations for one event — registrant account, tickets and attendees, amount, payments. Optionally only one registrant. Neon: GET /events/{id}/eventRegistrations.

page.description: 0-based page number (Neon pages start at 0). Default 0.

tools.name: neon_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List fundraising campaigns (id, code, name, status). Neon: GET /campaigns.

tools.name: neon_get_campaign
tools.title: Get one campaign
tools.description: Fetch one campaign — dates, goal, fund, purpose, parent campaign, status, page URLs and fundraising statistics. Neon: GET /campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: neon_get_activity
tools.title: Get one activity
tools.description: Fetch one activity (a logged interaction or task) — subject, note, dates, linked accounts, assigned users, status and priority. Neon: GET /activities/{id}.

tools.name: neon_list_properties
tools.title: List lookup values
tools.description: List one of the organization's lookup lists — the ids other tools need: funds, purposes, sources, solicitation methods, activity statuses and system time zones (for neon_create_activity), system users, individual and company types, event categories, countries, states/provinces, genders, prefixes. Neon: GET /properties/{name}.

tools.name: neon_create_account
tools.title: Create an account
tools.description: Create a constituent account: an INDIVIDUAL (a person) or a COMPANY (with company_name, plus an optional primary contact). Neon's Account Match may merge it into an existing account with the same name and email, so check neon_list_accounts by email first. Returns the new id. Neon: POST /accounts.

company_name.description: Company name — required when type is COMPANY.

phone.description: Phone number (stored on the primary address as phone1).

tools.name: neon_update_account
tools.title: Update an account
tools.description: Change an account's name, email, job title, company name or do-not-solicit / email opt-out flags. Only the fields you pass are changed (PATCH). The type must match the account (see neon_get_account). Addresses are not edited here. Neon: PATCH /accounts/{id}.

email_opt_out.description: Opt the primary email out of email (email1OptOut).

tools.name: neon_create_activity
tools.title: Log an activity
tools.description: Create an activity — log an interaction with a constituent (call, meeting, note) or schedule a task. Needs a subject, a start date, a time zone id (neon_list_properties name=systemTimezones), a status id (name=activityStatuses) and a priority; link it to accounts and assign it to system users. Returns the new id. Neon: POST /activities.

system_user_ids.description: System users it is assigned to.

tools.name: neon_update_activity
tools.title: Update an activity
tools.description: Change an activity's subject, note, status (e.g. mark it completed) or priority. Only the fields you pass are changed (PATCH). Neon: PATCH /activities/{id}.
